description: Laboratory experiments are based upon the corresponding theory course EEPC-211. An updated list of experiments is floated by the course coordinator before the beginning of each semester.
outcomes: Perform performance analysis of a DC machine.
Calculate the efficiency of a DC machine.
Determine the voltage regulation of a synchronous machine.
Measure the various reactances of a synchronous machine.
experiments: Perform Swinburne's test on a DC shunt motor.
Perform a direct load test on a DC compound generator.
Perform speed control of a DC shunt motor using armature and field control.
Perform a direct load test on a DC shunt motor and plot variation of input current, speed, torque and efficiency against output power.
Perform magnetization characteristics of a DC machine.
Measure the quadrature axis reactance of a synchronous machine.
Measure the synchronous impedance of a synchronous machine.
Measure the zero power factor characteristics of a synchronous machine.
Perform a slip test on a salient-pole machine.
